title: Romantic Getaway to Alberta: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Alberta. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Alberta sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Alberta. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Alberta for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Alberta
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Alberta](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1562674111-fa6a64c1b345?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Canada's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Villa rentals offer privacy and space for couples who want to create their own romantic retreat in Alberta.
